output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the transfer amount will cause an integer overflow. In the _transfer function, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; line, if _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.

The transferFrom function does not check if the transfer amount will cause an integer overflow. In the _transfer function, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; line, if _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.

The buy function does not check if the amount of tokens to be bought will cause an integer overflow. In the _transfer function, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; line, if _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.

The sell function does not check if the amount of tokens to be sold will cause an integer overflow. In the _transfer function, the balanceOf[_from] -= _value; line, if _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.
The mintToken function does not check if the mintedAmount will cause an integer overflow. In the totalSupply += mintedAmount; line, if mintedAmount is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.
